title: A MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND on a loan marked charged off and not fraud credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 883.10 and INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST 16.90, then debits the resolved fund source 7 900.00 exactly ONCE (loan 48 L477)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF under createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INTEREST_REFUND_FULL / loanProductId 48, loan 48 chargedOff true, fraud false) at refund transaction L477. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's merchantIssuedRefund transaction id 477 (externalId a5fa2326-c4a3-42ab-94e5-aab15dceef46, type Merchant Issued Refund, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 4): principalPortion 883.1 -> "88310", interestPortion 16.9 -> "1690", feeChargesPortion 0, penaltyChargesPortion 0, overpaymentPortion 0. The port REFUSES a fraud loan, so request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.fraud is false, matching the read-back's fraud false. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INTEREST_REFUND_FULL.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 12, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 12, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 13, incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17, fundSourceAccountId 7; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19, so paymentType 4 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 7. expect.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the three L477 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: JE 1256 CREDIT glAccountId 18 883.10, JE 1257 CREDIT glAccountId 16 16.90, JE 1258 DEBIT glAccountId 7 900.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a merchant-issued refund on a charged-off, non-fraud loan CREDITS every positive principal, interest, fee and penalty portion to its OWN charge-off slot — here principal to 18 and interest to 16, two distinct accounts so two credits — and DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source. A port that posts the refund through the charged-off REPAYMENT layout instead routes both portions to INCOME_FROM_RECOVERY 17, MERGING them into one 90000 credit and dropping the leg count from three to two — the account and count cells move while every side, amount and the single fund-source debit stay observed. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive overpayment, fee or penalty portion (all three are zero here), a merged positive fee/penalty credit, the fraud split (the port refuses a fraud loan), the method's unobserved payout-refund and goodwill-credit arms, or a zero-total case. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
